description: This file serves as the entry point for a React web application. It imports React libraries, styles, and the main App component, then renders the App component inside a DOM element with id 'root' using ReactDOM's createRoot API.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering React components into the DOM.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the specified React element into the created root.
